description: Protection-Paladin-with-Discipline-flavor tank - one-hand-and-shield block chassis, sustained by Justicar's Wrath self-healing, The Chosen's Illumination-fed shields, and avoidance/crit procs rather than active button-mashing.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Chosen of the Light, Sol Invictus, Dawnbreak, Dawnfall, Solar Nova confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: Solar Power spikes from Gavel strikes, Dawnbreak, crits (Sun Warrior's Guidance), and Vow fulfillment (Dawnguard), gating recurring empowered Dawn effects via Angelic Presence. Defense is mostly resource-free and automatic - block, avoidance procs, Justicar's Wrath self-heal, The Chosen shields off Illumination.

nodes.name: Stand Against Darkness
nodes.description: Reduces spell damage taken by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: MAGNITUDE CUT 2026-10-29 (Kyle's call: "bring Seraphim down to the field"). Seraphim measured 40% magic reduction against a field of 0-14%, the next best being Protection Paladin at 14, and led three tank axes at once. The MECHANIC is correct and stays - CoA names Gleaming Armor and Stand Against Darkness as this spec's passive spell mitigation and calls it a block-and-mitigate chassis that wins on attrition - so only the numbers moved. These two talents were also byte-identical to each other at -0.03 per rank, 15% each, which is where most of the 40 came from. Now 5% each, and with Battle Priest's unchanged 10% the spec sits at 20%: still the magic tank by a clear margin over Paladin's 14, no longer by 3x.

nodes.name: Seraphim
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Gavel of Light and Dawnbreak by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 20 Passive. Reduces Gavel of Light/Horusath Blast/Dawnbreak cooldowns.' Partially fixed during DPS niche audit (Oct 2026): the embedded ability_id was missing Dawnbreak's real id suffix - the actual ability is sun_cleric_dawnbreak_talent, not sun_cleric_dawnbreak. Retargeted the reference, but the key's own suffix (_cooldown_pct) is not one of the engine's real per-ability talent suffixes (only _cost/_cooldown/_damage/_potency are read anywhere in Ability, see combat/abilities.py) - a percentage-based cooldown reduction isn't supported at all today, only a flat-turns _cooldown is. This talent also mentions Gavel of Light and Horusath Blast, which this same key can't cover even by name (one key, three abilities) - a real gap beyond this one reference fix, flagged rather than silently built out.
